note: Two codings of the same 71 AAU member institutions. (1) Innovation: each institution's two strongest education initiatives, each scored 2×Novelty + Scale + Evidence (0–5 each, max 20); portfolio = mean of the top two, a missing second counts as 0. (2) Response to portable funding: direction (compete / supply / fortify / evidence / none) and which of four lenses showed a verified signal. Source: public university pages and news, 2025–2026. 'none' means not found in this scan, not proven absent.

directions.compete: Builds or runs an alternative that takes portable funds
directions.supply: Sells services or preparation to whoever is buying, including non-public schools
directions.evidence: Studies or debates the policy rather than acting in the market
directions.none: No response observed in this scan

lenses.1: Teacher preparation beyond traditional public schools
lenses.2: K–12 services offered to non-public students
